# EAS Workflow: iOS Simulator Build + Maestro Chat QA
#
# Runs on EAS cloud infrastructure (macOS runners).
# Requires: EXPO_TOKEN in EAS secrets, EAS project configured.
#
# Trigger: eas workflow ios-chat-simulator-qa --non-interactive
# Or:      eas workflow .eas/workflows/ios-chat-simulator-qa.yml

name: ios-chat-simulator-qa

on:
  push:
    branches: [main, master]
    paths:
      - "expo/app/ivx/chat.tsx"
      - "expo/src/modules/chat/**"
      - "expo/.maestro/**"
  workflow_dispatch:

defaults:
  resource_class: m-medium
  env:
    OWNER_EMAIL: ${{ secrets.OWNER_EMAIL }}
    OWNER_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.OWNER_PASSWORD }}
    EXPO_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL: https://api.ivxholding.com

jobs:
  build-ios-simulator:
    name: Build iOS Simulator App
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout
        with:
          path: expo
      - uses: actions/setup-node
        with:
          node-version: 20
      - uses: actions/setup-bun
        with:
          bun-version: latest
      - name: Install dependencies
        working-directory: expo
        run: bun install --frozen-lockfile
      - name: Build iOS simulator
        working-directory: expo
        run: |
          export EXPO_PUBLIC_SOURCE_COMMIT_SHA="${{ github.sha }}"
          export EXPO_PUBLIC_QA_BUILD=true
          npx eas-cli build --profile ios-simulator-qa --platform ios --non-interactive --output=build/ios-simulator.tar.gz
      - name: Upload build artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact
        with:
          name: ios-simulator-build
          path: expo/build/ios-simulator.tar.gz
          retention-days: 14

  maestro-chat-qa:
    name: Run Maestro Chat QA (20-step)
    needs: build-ios-simulator
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout
        with:
          path: expo
      - uses: actions/setup-node
        with:
          node-version: 20
      - uses: actions/setup-bun
        with:
          bun-version: latest
      - name: Install Maestro
        run: |
          curl -Ls "https://get.maestro.mobile.dev" | bash
          export PATH="$HOME/.maestro/bin:$PATH"
          maestro --version
      - name: Download build artifact
        uses: actions/download-artifact
        with:
          name: ios-simulator-build
          path: expo/build
      - name: Boot iOS Simulator
        run: |
          xcrun simctl boot "iPhone 15 Pro" || true
          xcrun simctl install booted expo/build/IVXHoldings.app
      - name: Run 20-step chat QA
        working-directory: expo
        run: |
          export PATH="$HOME/.maestro/bin:$PATH"
          export OWNER_EMAIL="${{ secrets.OWNER_EMAIL }}"
          export OWNER_PASSWORD="${{ secrets.OWNER_PASSWORD }}"
          maestro test .maestro/ivx-chat-full-qa.yaml --format junit --output maestro-results.xml
      - name: Upload Maestro results
        uses: actions/upload-artifact
        with:
          name: maestro-chat-qa-results
          path: expo/maestro-results.xml
          retention-days: 30
      - name: Upload screenshots
        uses: actions/upload-artifact
        with:
          name: maestro-screenshots
          path: expo/.maestro/screenshots/
          retention-days: 14
